title: Cola for Breakfast?
setting: A family house: a bathroom upstairs and a kitchen downstairs.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue t-shirt

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna, a young girl with long blonde hair and a red sweater

sentences.en: Ben wakes up early and looks at the clock.
sentences.zh: 本很早就醒了，看了看时钟。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue t-shirt sits up in bed and looks at a clock on the wall, early morning light outside.

sentences.en: He takes a warm shower and washes his head.
sentences.zh: 他洗了个热水澡，还洗了头。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue t-shirt stands under a warm shower and washes his hair with soap.

sentences.en: Then he runs downstairs to the kitchen.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue t-shirt runs down the stairs toward the kitchen.

sentences.en: "Hey, Ben, your meal is ready!" says Anna.
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna, a young girl with long blonde hair and a red sweater calls and waves to Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue t-shirt from a kitchen table with breakfast on it.

sentences.en: Their grey pet cat sleeps on a chair.
sentences.zh: 他们家的灰色宠物猫睡在一把椅子上。
sentences.scene_prompt: A grey cat sleeps on a kitchen chair next to Anna, a young girl with long blonde hair and a red sweater.

sentences.en: Ben is not interested in these eggs.
sentences.zh: 本对这些鸡蛋不感兴趣。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue t-shirt looks without interest at a plate of eggs on the table.

sentences.en: He wants something else: cola, his favourite drink.
sentences.zh: 他想要别的东西：可乐，他最喜欢的饮料。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue t-shirt reaches for a bottle of cola on the table.

sentences.en: Anna says he can have some, but not much.
sentences.zh: 安娜说他可以喝一点，但不能喝很多。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna, a young girl with long blonde hair and a red sweater pours a little cola into a small glass for Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue t-shirt.
